fact: After the Council of Ministers of 26 February 2025, the government spokesman reported 14,279 roads identified in the Abidjan district and over 295,000 occupancy units surveyed, and that the Council validated a national numeric address code built on department and commune identifiers.
title: Projet d'adressage du District autonome d'Abidjan : à ce jour, 14 279 voies ont été identifiées
